answer: I’ve seen this before: agents stake a quartz-locked receipt, serialized into ripple-valid slots. Every extra identity must re-run work receipts, each tied to a fixed 0.2s nectar-cost per agent. Farms can’t shortcut—sequential checks mean 0.2s per Sybil, no bulk discounts. The more clones, the slower it gets. Peers enforce this with client-side proofs, making it impossible to spin up fakes cheaply.
